lines: Chamomile next. A startled goat holds the footbridge — nothing crosses while it stamps.
Chamomile hangs by the doors of the wise against ill luck. Find some. Soothe the beast.
dialogue_b2_intro.speaker: witch

lines: Two herbs. The goat will dine out on this story for years.
East. The tall grass hums — mind it.
dialogue_b2_outro.speaker: witch

lines: Chamomile. Small flowers, soft hands.
Easy, now. Easy.
dialogue_b2_pickup.speaker: apprentice

lines: Fennel grows past the swarm field. They guard the tall grass jealously.
Time their drifting, or burn fennel to scatter them. Fennel fears no pest.
dialogue_b3_intro.speaker: witch

lines: Three herbs. The field will buzz about you.
The forest edge lies ahead, and something there wears a borrowed shape.
dialogue_b3_outro.speaker: witch

lines: Fennel. Smell that — strength itself.
Now, through or around them.
dialogue_b3_pickup.speaker: apprentice

lines: Betony. It waits past the forest edge, where a will-o'-wisp paints false paths.
Trust nothing that shimmers. Burn betony, and walk the real stone.
dialogue_b4_intro.speaker: witch

lines: Four herbs. The charm takes shape.
Rest. The deep forest — and plantain — will ask harder things of you.
dialogue_b4_outro.speaker: witch

lines: Betony. Against nightmares and false faces.
Now show me what you really are.
dialogue_b4_pickup.speaker: apprentice

lines: Mugwort. Mother of herbs.
One herb for the charm. Now walk it home — east, through the door.
dialogue_beat1_pickup.speaker: apprentice

lines: Mugwort first. The potting shed keeps its jars on three high shelves — higher than any apprentice can jump, and the herb moves shelf to shelf.
An inch of dust on every jar, and bare hands will only smear it. Conjure a cloth, wipe them clean to read the labels.
Need to get up there? Type it (T) — a ladder, perhaps. Mind the ink: fifty conjurings a trip.
dialogue_level01_intro.speaker: witch

lines: One herb found, eight to go.
The charm is patient. The patient is not — back out there soon.
dialogue_level01_outro.speaker: witch
